h: The Three Avos Guide the Journey Toward Complete Rest

p: In the Minchah prayer of Shabbos
In the holy Zohar (on this parshah, Zohar III 150b):
"In the place where the Avos are found,
are found with them," and so on.
and then Knesses Yisrael is crowned
Therefore at the third meal of Shabbos,
the holiness of all three Avos,
which are the holiness of the three meals
these are Moshe and Aharon, Yosef and David,
and they are the sons of Yaakov.
in the Minchah prayer of Shabbos,
and we say "Yaakov and his sons,"
And likewise Shabbos is the Daughter
who is crowned with the Avos
and Moshe is the groomsman of the King,
and Aharon the groomsman of the Queen
and Aharon, the groomsman of the Queen,
which is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
"He shall be a mouth for you,"
"For the lips of the Kohen guard knowledge,
and they seek Torah from his mouth."
the Torah was given to Yisrael on Shabbos
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 47b):
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
Thus the holiness of Moshe and Aharon
And concerning Yosef it is stated
And the holiness of David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
which is the attribute of Malchus,
for Shabbos is the seventh day,
we mention the Avos in this prayer,
and also say "Yaakov and his sons":
"his sons" corresponds to the other tzaddikim,
and we say "they rest on it,"
it is stated in the holy Zohar:
journey with them," and so on.

p: "And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
to bring them into Eretz Yisrael immediately";
and so it is in the Sifrei.
Now this needs to be understood:
there is surely no restraint upon Hashem
to bring them in an instant,
in a single day, to Eretz Yisrael;
did they travel only a three days' journey?
גַּם אַחַר כָּךְ כְּתִיב גַּם כֵּן
Also afterward it is likewise written:
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
to seek out a resting place for them";
for the attributes of Chessed, Gevurah and Tiferes,
and the attributes are called days,
as is written in the holy Zohar here
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה (שְׁמוֹת כ, יא)
And it is known that they correspond to
which drive a person out of the world
Avraham's attribute is love of people,
and it stands against the kelipah of jealousy,
"You hated the blood of a person
within his body," and so on.
"a mighty one is he who conquers his yetzer";
and it stands against the kelipah of Yishmael,
מִמִּדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
of the attribute of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"The God who has shepherded me all my life…";
And it stands against the kelipah of Amalek,
which is "Amalek, the first of the nations" (Bamidbar 24:20);
is the first of the kelipah.
As is written in the holy Zohar
about the primordial kings who died,
for at the creation of the world,
"Hashem reigns, He is clothed in majesty,"
there was a garment of majesty
and that is the kelipah of Amalek,
וְאֵת כָּל אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּלוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגוֹ׳
and all that the king had promoted him…";
for even though they truly recognized
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
at the time of the effort and the service
with his own strength, in his own attribute,
"My strength and the might of my hand
to conquer the world through murder,
only for cravings and evil desires.
who said, "The God who shepherds me…";
for about him too it says in the Gemara
"who ran before Me like horses," and so on
and nothing of it from his own strength;
and therefore even among his offspring
no refuse at all was found,
Now a person all the days of his life
is in the state of one who journeys,
for all his days he is called one who goes.
when he comes to the World to Come,
call the death of the tzaddikim
And the essential purpose of the journey
of the aspect of the three Avos,
from which one must go out.
And this is what it says:
"And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
which are called days, as mentioned above.
For Hashem Yisbarach wished them to journey,
so that they would be occupied
on the path of these three attributes,
so that they would be able to come to Eretz Yisrael,
for there is the Beis HaMikdash,
And the essence of complete rest
about the generation of the wilderness
that they have no share in the World to Come,
"They shall not come into My rest."
אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם כֵּן נִקְרָא מְנוּחָה
"To this rest they do not come,
but they do come to another rest."

p: And this is what it says afterward:
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
for the power of the Torah
and to come by way of the three days,
which are the three attributes of the Avos,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רב, א)
As is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 202a):
I created for it the Torah as an antidote."
And this is "to seek out a resting place for them":
that they would be able to come to Eretz Yisrael immediately,
"And it was, when the Ark journeyed";
as they learned in the Gemara (Berachos 11a):
"'And when you go' — when it is your own going you are obligated,
but on a mitzvah journey you are exempt,"
with regard to the preoccupation of a mitzvah.
"Arise, Hashem, and let Your enemies be scattered,
and let those who hate You flee";
who is simply a hater and an enemy.
"And when it rested he would say" (Bamidbar 10:36):
which is the attribute of Malchus:
that the Shechinah does not rest
And this is the number of the Levi'im
who came to redeem the firstborn.
that the holiness of the camp of the Levi'im
is such that even the zav is sent out of it.
who comes from the kelipah of jealousy,
is sent out of the entire camp of Yisrael;
who comes from the kelipah of desire,
is sent out only from the camp of the Levi'im;
for one whose toil is in Torah,
and who are free only for Torah and avodah,
which is the aspect of the Levi'im,
can conquer the yetzer of desire
so that it is only for words of Torah,
which are the heads of the kelipos,
from the kelipah of desire and of jealousy;
and then, as a matter of course, one merits to conquer
the kelipah of arrogance as well,
which stands against the attribute of Yaakov;
and this one merits from Hashem Yisbarach.
And this is why it mentions afterward
כִּי בָעֲרָה בָם אֵשׁ ה׳ (שָׁם יא, ג)
"for the fire of Hashem burned among them" (Bamidbar 11:3);
and this stands against the kelipah of jealousy.
then as a matter of course they are refined
in the third trait as well;
for these two are the main thing,
"And when she journeys, she journeys with the Avos;
and then Knesses Yisrael is crowned
And on Shabbos, at the third meal,
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the other tzaddikim with them;
that is a semblance of the World to Come.
And this is what we say at this meal:
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it":

paragraphs.text: Source: Bamidbar 11:3 — “ויקרא שם המקום ההוא תבערה כי בערה בם אש יהוה” — “That place was named Taberah, because a fire of יהוה had broken out against them.”
